SCT2025.title: Quantifying the Spectrum of Early Motor and Language Milestones in Sex Chromosome Trisomy

rules.action: Discuss the current developmental concern with the child's clinician to decide on assessment or referral.
rules.reason: An explicit current concern can justify review between routine screening visits.

rules.action: Discuss a documented plan for speech, learning and psychosocial monitoring with the care team.
rules.reason: XXY guidance supports monitoring and appropriate support; the pack does not prescribe an assessment interval or infer impairment.

rules.action: Discuss an individualized developmental follow-up plan with the care team.
rules.reason: A prospective SCT milestone study supports closer developmental assessment, but does not establish an individualized 24-month risk probability or a mandatory visit schedule.

rules.action: Review completion or arrange age-appropriate standardized developmental screening with the clinician.
rules.reason: US guidance specifies screening ages and catch-up at the next visit when a screening was missed. The software combines older missed slots into a single catch-up review.

rules.action: Review completion or arrange age-appropriate autism screening with the clinician.
rules.reason: US guidance identifies routine screening ages. Screening is not a diagnosis and no questionnaire is embedded in the package.
